title: threshmh: exact and metaheuristic multilevel image thresholding
description: Multilevel Otsu and Kapur thresholding admit an exact O(C L^2) dynamic-programming solution. This package implements that solver and benchmarks four metaheuristics against it across 28,000 runs on 14 images at C in {2..6}, with the evaluation budget enforced inside the objective and non-parametric statistical analysis throughout. The exact solver returns the proven optimum in every case in 3.4 to 7.8 ms, flat in the number of classes; the metaheuristics reach it between 48 and 81 per cent of the time at C=6. Includes a MATLAB bridge and a comparison against scikit-image's threshold_multiotsu.
